record.question: What does the term "victim" mean under the CrPC?
options: Any complainant in the criminal case.
A person who has suffered any loss or injury caused due to crime but not includes his or her guardian or legal heir.
A person who has suffered any loss or injury caused due to crime and includes his or her guardian or legal heir.
